scope: Independent read-only terminal evidence audit; no benchmark rerun/model/media/server/product workload.

samplingAndImportOrderEvidence.limitation: The first raw sample containing the actual identity is timestamped after atomic acknowledgement in that iteration; frozen parent code calls owned.sample and observed_workload before publishing the acknowledgement. No separate import telemetry is fabricated.

memoryScope: Actual interpreter Windows OS peak working set and process commit are distinct from sampled aggregate owned-tree RSS/private. Peak_pagefile is commit, not disk size. Imports/export/fidelity work count toward process peaks; shared RSS can be counted twice and sampled peaks can be missed.
diskScope: Database/sidecar lengths are actual child-reported pre-cleanup logical sizes, arithmetically checked against bound receipts; scratch is absent now. The audit does not retrospectively remeasure deleted databases or treat lengths as allocated blocks.
limitations: One paired case per count, no repetitions or throughput qualification.
Dense synthetic pose/racket observations only; complete unknown/empty ground-motion summaries intentionally exclude unrelated pipeline arrays.
No real render, inference, model, accuracy, physical-speed/3D or full-match qualification.
The disk-backed 18000 case uses less resident memory and is slower in construction/indexed-read/export spans; these are separate outcomes.
